title: Diagram Piece Must Render In Scene With Correct Type Model
prompt: Fix and validate Sketchpad Design behavior so newly added diagram pieces render in scene with the correct type model. When a piece is added in the Diagram window, it must appear in the Scene window immediately with the correct model associated with that piece's type.
